headline: As of 2026-10-16: 6,747,311 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 38 of 50 states, D+20.6 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 6,747,311 early/mail ballots cast so far across 38 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+20.6 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (859,782), Florida (741,136), Virginia (604,369).
